cc:Work.dc:title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next DSpark per-position training accuracy at epoch 10
cc:Work.dc:description: Exact logged values at optimizer step 26040; latest wall-time record is selected if the same step repeats. Display positions 1–7 map to input files acc-pos0 through acc-pos6. Left: Baseline and Engram-Markov accuracy. Right: Engram-Markov minus Baseline in percentage points.
